error.invalid_auth: Login with Amazon rejected this Client ID and Client secret. Copy them again from the skill's Permissions page (Send Alexa Events), clicking Show before copying the secret.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Login with Amazon. Check the connection and try again.

confirm.title: Confirm selection
confirm.description: With this selection you will share {count} entities with Alexa. Entities that drop out will be removed from Alexa.

stock_alexa_configured.title: Built-in Alexa integration also configured
stock_alexa_configured.description: The built-in Alexa integration is also configured: remove the alexa: block from configuration.yaml to avoid duplicate responses.

proactive_not_authorized.title: Alexa link or events refused
proactive_not_authorized.description: Login with Amazon refused Home Assistant: either linking the skill failed or Alexa rejects the events it sends. Check the Client ID and Client secret under Send Alexa Events on the skill Permissions page, re-enter them in the integration if needed, then disable and re-enable the skill in the Alexa app.
